name: Invoice / Receipt Extractor
description: Watches Gmail for invoice and receipt attachments, extracts structured data with Google Gemini, validates the totals, archives the file in Google Drive, logs a row in Google Sheets, and notifies Slack.

credentials.name: Gmail account
credentials.purpose: Poll for attachments, mark messages read, send the test invoices

credentials.name: Google Gemini(PaLM) Api account
credentials.purpose: Document and image extraction via models/gemini-2.5-flash

credentials.name: Google Drive account
credentials.purpose: Archive the original attachment and return a shareable link

credentials.name: Google Sheets account
credentials.purpose: Append one row per invoice to the Invoices Log

credentials.name: Slack account
credentials.purpose: Post the logged / review-required / failure notifications
